The two balls carry equal amounts of the same kind of charge, and B is subjected to A's Coulomb repulsive force horizontally to the right. B is stationary on the smooth inclined plane, and is balanced along the inclined-plane direction: the component of the electric force upward along the inclined plane is F cos30°, and the component of gravity downward along the inclined plane is mg sin30°, so F cos30° = mg sin30°, that is, F = mg tan30°. m = 30√3 g = 0.030√3 kg, g = 10 m/s², so F = 0.030√3 × 10 × 1/√3 = 0.30 N. From Coulomb's law F = kq²/r², taking k = 9.0×10^9 N·m²/C², obtain q = sqrt(F r² / k) = sqrt[0.30 × (0.10√3)^2 / (9.0×10^9)] = sqrt(1.0×10^-12) = 1.0×10^-6 C.
